parse_predictions: parse model predictions to oriented bounding box parameters and suppress overlapping boxes using NMS
parse_groundtruths: parse groundtruth labels to oriented bounding box parameters for 3D object detection evaluation
create_apc_calculator: create an APCalculator instance to compute average precision metrics for 3D object detection
accumulate_detection_results: accumulate batch predictions and groundtruths into APCalculator for incremental metric computation
compute_detection_metrics: compute average precision, recall, and mean AP metrics from accumulated detection results
